Definition: Ashshur, the second son of Shem; also his descendants and the country occupied by them (i.e. Assyria), its region and its empire
BiblicalUsage: Asshur or Assyria = "a step"; n pr m; 1) the second son of Shem, eponymous ancestor of the Assyrians; 2) the people of Assyria; n pr loc; 3) the nation, Assyria; 4) the land, Assyria or Asshur
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
